narr: Amid a hot and humid air mass, showers and thunderstorms developed during the afternoon hours on August 4, 2022. Some thunderstorms became severe producing downed trees and power lines as well as heavy rainfall leading to flash flooding. Flash flooding was mainly confined to the Town of Bethlehem as training thunderstorms produced upwards of 4 inches of rain in just a couple of hours.
ev: Route 85 was closed between Kenwood Avenue and Bridge Street in the Town of Bethlehem due to flooding.
lsr: ROUTE 85 CLOSED BETWEEN KENWOOD AVENUE AND BRIDGE STREET IN THE TOWN OF BETHLEHEM DUE TO FLOODING.
